verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office platform covering company formation, compliance, bookkeeping and tax, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question for it. The pack contains no evidence of user-issuable API keys, scopes, or least-privilege controls. The "Advanced API integrations" line on the pricing page is an unexplained bookkeeping feature, not credential issuance. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404. The "registered agent" items refer to a legal service, not AI agents.
